-83.03810,40.05850.name: Ohio Reproductive Medicine
-83.03810,40.05850.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Grant E. Schmidt, MD, PHD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.14592,51.52131.name: London Fertility Centre
-0.14592,51.52131.state: 53, Portland Place, London, W1B 1QJ, United Kingdom
-0.14592,51.52131.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.
